Subject: Follow-up & capacity ask — Acme AI POC

Hi Sophie / Tom — great meeting today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from redwood side: 

1) Success criteria (as discussed):
- Latency: p50 < 200ms and p95 < 600ms for chat workload with 1k concurrent users in test harness.
- Throughput: sustained 60k tokens/minute for embedding batch workload.
- Quality: parity with your current baseline on our eval prompts (we'll share diff report).

2) Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (next Mon 6/15): kickoff + env access + dataset sync.
- Weeks 1-3: POC run with 2 workloads (chat & embeddings), daily dashboards.
- Week 4: final report and decision meeting.

3) Ownership:
- Acme: Sophie (PM) is owner for success criteria and test data; Tom is procurement contact.
- Redwood: Marissa (sales) + Vivek (solutions/infra) are owners for capacity and infra.

4) Capacity ask (initial):
- Requesting reserved baseline: 4 x A100-40GB (reserved) for predictable baseline.
- Autoscale policy to allow burst up to 8 nodes (short bursts to 12 on approval) for peak test windows.
- Min nodes: 2, Max nodes: 8; burst policy: +50% for 10 minutes during load tests.

I've attached a simple capacity estimate spreadsheet and success-criteria doc. Please confirm Sophie that these numbers look reasonable so we can provision reserved capacity ahead of the kickoff.

Next steps: please confirm by EOD Fri (6/12) so we can lock reservations. If you want different GPU types (e.g., 80GB or cheaper 3090-style options) we can run a cost/latency tradeoff in parallel.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie@acme.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & capacity ask — Acme AI POC

Hi Sophie — quick answers to infra questions: 
1) KV cache: our runtime supports prefix/KV caching that is sticky to a node for warm cache hits. During autoscale, we keep a small rolling cache sync and use a shared prewarm mechanism for new nodes to pull recent prefixes. For POC we recommend using sticky sessions for the chat test windows to minimize cache churn.

2) Cold-start: typical profile for a new node with model loaded and quantized weights is ~45-90s to be ready for traffic depending on model size (we'll provide exact numbers once you lock the model variant). We plan to pre-warm instances 2 minutes before scheduled load tests to avoid cold-start hit.

Capacity notes:
- With 4 x A100 baseline and autoscale to 8, we estimate headroom for your expected sustained 60k tokens/minute on embeddings and ~1k concurrent chat users with target latencies. See attached capacity sheet for assumptions (batch size, token/sec per GPU).

Action items:
- Marissa: can you provision reserved nodes (4) for week starting 6/15?
- Sophie: please share the baseline test prompts and the estimated peak RPS windows.

Thanks,
Vivek
